name: cinelink-bridge
description: SAB — Sony ATEM Bridge: modular camera control platform

scripts.pkg:universal: npm run pkg:arm64 && npm run pkg:x64 && lipo -create dist/cinelink-bridge-arm64 dist/cinelink-bridge-x64 -output dist/cinelink-bridge-universal
scripts.bundle:app: npm run pkg:universal && cp dist/cinelink-bridge-universal 'CineLink Bridge.app/Contents/MacOS/cinelink-bridge' && chmod +x 'CineLink Bridge.app/Contents/MacOS/cinelink-bridge'
